name: Shirogane no Cal Digital Performance
source:
Akatsuki no Amaneka to Aoi Kyojin's heroine Cal Ruslan got so popular that her story is transformed into a new separate game without gameplay elements.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《晓之阿玛奈卡与苍蓝巨神》的女主角卡尔·鲁斯兰人气极高，因此她的故事被改编成了一部不含游戏玩法要素的独立新作。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
